reason: I grab my Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way, and I'm not ordering cans off some e-shop or hunting for a bistro that stocks it. 80 mg is less of a kick than I'm used to for an exam night, and 55 crowns is more than a Monster.
objection: I can't just pick it up where I already buy my energy drinks, and with an English label I'm not even sure it's a Czech brand or who's behind it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert or Tesco next to Red Bull, ideally at around 40 CZK, so I could try one without any effort.
